$description: Motion tokens for me-google-default. Durations are DTCG duration objects; easing curves are cubicBezier. Comfort caps enforce ADR-005 §4 motion-safety limits (angular velocity <= 30 deg/s comfortable, hard fail > 60 deg/s; scale change <= 0.3x/s; snap < 100 ms).

snap.$description: Snap/quick transitions (>= 100 ms to avoid too-fast sim-sickness risk).

emphasized.$description: Emphasized motion for spatial focus changes.

maxAngularVelocityDegPerSec.$description: Comfortable angular velocity cap for animated content (ADR-005). Hard fail > 60 deg/s.

maxScaleChangePerSec.$description: Max scale change per second to limit looming/zoom sickness.

reducedMotionMultiplier.$description: Multiplier applied to all durations when reduced-motion is active (0 = instant).

parallaxEnabled.$description: 1 = parallax enabled; reduced-motion override sets this to 0.
